topic: What if gravity doubled every hour?

script.text: Seven AM. Your alarm goes off. You roll out of bed, and you hit the floor like a sack of cement.
Your arms feel like they're full of sand. Your phone slides off the nightstand and smacks into the carpet. Hard.
In the kitchen, your mom pours cereal. It doesn't fall into the bowl. It shoots into it. The milk lands so hard it splashes the ceiling.
Your dog Biscuit is lying flat on the floor, like a rug. He doesn't even try to get up.
Outside, a pigeon on the fence flaps like crazy, gets one foot in the air, and gives up.
You check the weather app on your phone. Then a different app. The one that measures how hard the Earth is pulling. It says nineteen point six. It's supposed to say nine point eight.
Gravity just doubled. And at eight o'clock, it's going to double again.
What if gravity doubled every hour?
